title: getBy, queryBy, findBy: pick by what you expect

slides.say: Every query comes in three flavors. Pick by what you expect to happen.
Get by throws if nothing matches. Query by returns null instead. Find by returns a promise that waits for the element to appear.
So to check that something is NOT there, use query by. Get by would throw before your expect even runs.

slides.text: All three throw if MORE than one element matches. Use getAllBy / queryAllBy / findAllBy for lists.
slides.say: One more rule. All three throw if more than one element matches. For lists, use the all versions, which return arrays.
